principles: one accountable owner per decision surface
fast flow with bounded cognitive load
limit WIP and pull work by capacity
one hypothesis -> one intervention -> one measurable result
defer to expertise closest to the evidence
freeze normal work during integrity incidents

handoffs.analyzer_to_front: after semantic classification or material policy/architecture change
handoffs.supervisor_to_front: only blocker, integrity conflict, dispatch failure or hours exception

publish: daily plan or closeout when requested

continuous_work_law.rule: While clocked in, every department keeps useful authorized work moving whenever such work exists.
continuous_work_law.task_completion: Record result, perform handoff, then pull the next safe objective from Daily Plan / durable next_action / accepted roadmap / Front queue.
ask_user_only_for: manual or UI action unavailable to tools
explicit authorization for risky destructive irreversible or out-of-scope work
unresolved roadmap choice not covered by existing policy
blocker only the user can clear
never_ask_for: minor implementation decisions covered by accepted architecture
ordinary evidence review indexing builds static checks or registered safe tests
continuous_work_law.empty_queue: Front Office derives the next smallest evidence-backed objective instead of asking the user what to do.
